identity.name: VibeStitch
identity.mission: To kill boring apparel with vibrant, user-created chaos.
identity.target_audience: Gen Z creators, streetwear enthusiasts, and brands looking for merch.

theme.strategy: Clean canvas (white/slate) with explosive color accents to highlight user creativity.

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, hero text, and product names. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for descriptions, UI elements, and inputs. Relaxed line-height.

primary.name: Electric Indigo
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, active states, brand logos.

spacing.base: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for section padding.
spacing.containers: Max-width-7xl centered. Always use px-4 or px-6 on mobile.

grids.bento: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Mix col-span-2 for feature highlights.
grids.masonry: For sticker galleries. Allow items to have variable heights.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white px-8 py-3 font-bold shadow-lg hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-indigo-500/30 transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-white text-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-200 px-8 py-3 font-bold hover:border-indigo-200 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all

cards.product: group relative rounded-3xl bg-white border border-slate-100 p-4 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden
cards.feature: rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-8 border border-slate-100 hover:bg-white hover:shadow-md transition-colors

inputs.default: rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border-transparent px-4 py-3 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400

navigation.navbar: fixed top-4 left-4 right-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg border border-slate-200/50 shadow-lg z-50 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for almost everything. Avoid sharp corners.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used heavily in the Customizer toolbars to keep the product visible.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Buttons scale on click. Cards lift on hover. Icons rotate on hover.

hero_main.desc: Woman and boy in white tees, clean studio background. Use for Hero.

product_men.desc: Man in white tee, front view. Use for Product Card.

product_women.desc: Woman with glasses in white tee. Use for Product Card.

sticker_assets.desc: Colorful buttons/badges. Use as floating sticker elements.
Fabric textures. Use for background patterns.

lifestyle.desc: Urban street night vibe. Use for 'Community' or 'About' section.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a high-energy, trustworthy e-commerce experience. Do not make it look like a generic dashboard. It should feel like a creative studio.
instructions_to_main_agent.customizer_logic: The Customizer is the core. It must feel like a native app. Use absolute positioning for the canvas and floating panels for tools.
instructions_to_main_agent.mobile_responsiveness: On mobile, the Customizer tools should slide up from the bottom (Drawer) instead of floating on the side.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions and complex interactions. Use 'tailwindcss-animate' for simple UI states.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
